title: Dalrymple availability: four official PDFs recovered and key pages visually checked
summary: Nine pages from four official reports were visually inspected after the approved access repair. The report-4 period and final-report discrepancy corroborate the existing amendment. Earlier text-only access failures remain preserved; no observation, interval denominator or admitted series is added.
evidence_note: The new receipt records PDF hashes, byte counts and exact inspected pages. This later success supersedes only the earlier access limits, not the historical receipt or admission requirements. Contractual calculation, interval records and genuine independent acceptance remain outstanding.
publication_effect: Local source-review follow-up only; no independent admission, issuer correction, publication approval or Phase 60 decision.
